propositions: Codex has no Serena MCP entry configured, preventing project-scoped semantic navigation and symbol lookup
Project-scoped MCP servers must be added to .codex/config.toml with Serena pinned to commit c7dbe3bd1198cf451bf7aa8fdeeab88571fa3a6e and launched via uvx
Serena start-mcp-server must be invoked with --context codex and --project-from-cwd to enable worktree-aware semantic analysis without user-specific paths
MCP server entry requires startup_timeout_sec=120 to accommodate cold uvx resolution and must remain non-required so Serena failures do not block Codex operation
Configuration must be validated via TOML parsing, codex mcp list discovery, Serena CLI smoke test, and MCP initialize/list-tools handshake; project scope must not leak to untrusted directories
